payload.title: Review provided-address inbox usability and safe subscription handling
payload.description:
Design-only planning requested by Ryan during voice. Implementation remains unstarted; no code, infrastructure, deployment, purchase or publishing authorization is implied. Initial status stays open (Discovery), unassigned.

Acceptance review depends on inbox behavior PPY-7a2a53d7-0e93-4ee9-b8c3-732125a86537 and author/operator documentation PPY-d97519f8-a11e-4501-a558-8be1027e9f2a. Walk an authorized user's original-message reader including sender/date, derived-reference provenance and processing/pending/error visibility. Verify cross-publication/user isolation, readable original rendering and privacy/retention decisions. Demonstrate scanners do not activate confirmation, unsubscribe, preferences, login or other account actions; only a deliberate authorized human action may manage a subscription. Verify pause status never claims unsubscribe and hidden ingestion alone cannot pass. Check scope excludes a full compose/reply client. Record actual implementation evidence versus planned behavior; no message action, mailbox connection, subscription or infrastructure change in this planning task.
